from datetime import datetime

def fetch_all_text(access_token, phone_number):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_text_messages(access_token=access_token, phone_number=phone_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('text page',page_index,'->',len(page) if page else 0)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return results

def fetch_all_voice(access_token, phone_number):
    results=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.phone.search_voice_messages(access_token=access_token, phone_number=phone_number, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        print('voice page',page_index,'->',len(page) if page else 0)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index+=1
    return results
